replies.author: Junr
replies.body:
Yeah , I decided to appeal your ban since this is the only evidence I have as of now, so I will get your banned appealed asap. I'm sorry that this happened and I will make sure this won't happen again. I have two main reasons on appealing you and they are:
1. The evidence is too laggy and not clear for you to actually detect if you are hacking.
2. I was in TS listening to someone's issues in the support room with my attention focusing on there more and not in game.
Again, I am absolutley sorry for this inconvience and if I caused any trouble, I am sorry, yeah, I do get sometimes you can accidentally bump your mouse which can make you look like a cheater.
Your appeal has been accepted and your ban should be appealed soon.
Have a nice day!
